note: The Handover mission layer, moved out of the world: destinations and crew (block frame, from the old handover-block.json, suborned.block/2), the plan routes (getaway, official), and the rules that read them (C-3 mission points land on a plot or street, M-1 routes reach their end, W-1 walk origins from standards.walking.from). The world holds none of it. Input to brief 003. Run: bun tools/plan/cli.ts --overlay tools/missions/handover/overlay.ts. suborned.mission/2 (2026-10-14) adds the schedule the world's life rules held until Pulse regenerated them: status, clock, timeline, events, stands. Re-sited 2026-10-14 (Waymark; brief 008 B2, Vantage): the Records Office doors now stand on its tower faces, so four door points follow them. Office entrance (54.65, -30.5) to (51.75, -30), on the public landing 0.75 m up six steps; Office approach (52, -30.5) to (48.6, -30), at the foot of those steps; Official entrance and Meet Vale (73.25, -31) to (76.25, -30), the flush official door under the canopy. 'Steps' is renamed 'Terrace gate' (the café door is flush, there are no steps; the point has not moved). The door points equal the civic block's entrances: tools/missions/handover/moves.test.ts. Nothing else is re-sited and nothing is re-timed: every schedule entry is a clock offset from GDD §07 and names no leg and no walking pace, so none follows from a length that changed. Every time is a mission-clock offset; GDD §07 is the authority for the timeline. The removed originals, verbatim: git show 15af5dd:contracts/world/harbour-district.life.json (clock.mission, clock.anchors, events.list[0], traffic.rules[3], generator.civicEmployers[0].shiftEnd, transit.schedule). suborned.mission/3 (2026-10-15, Waymark; brief 010 D) adds roles: the people the mission needs by role (employer, position or role, mission point, shift window), never by person; the overlay casts each from the generated people and pins one by id (rule M-2). Schema: contracts/missions/mission.schema.ts. Test: tools/missions/handover/mission.test.ts.

Brief 003 stays on hold for that.
